notes: Baked 2026-11-16 by bake_other_side_20261116/scripts/ink_solver.py + ink_export.py. NOT Mantaflow: Mantaflow gas smeared the dye into a soft puff, so the sim is a custom incompressible solver (192^3 periodic grid, MacCormack advection, FFT projection, vorticity confinement, decaying negative buoyancy) with the dye carried by 40M tracer particles (no numerical diffusion), splatted and resampled to 96^3. Atlas: 960x960 RGB, 10x10 cells of 96x96, slice k at col k%10,row floor(k/10), slice 0 = bottom, last 4 cells black; in a cell image x = sim X, image y (top->bottom) = sim Y (depth). R = round(255 * pow(linearDensity, densityGamma)) -> decode linear = pow(R/255, 1/densityGamma). linearDensity is normalised PER FRAME (99th percentile of the cloud = 1, smoothed over time) so late wisps keep usable values; extra field densityScale[i] = true density of R=255 in frame i relative to frame 0 (multiply by it to get the physical dilution; ignore it for a constant-brightness look). A small linear toe (see field densityToe) is subtracted to drop the faint unstirred haze; R<3 zeroed. G = fraction of dye B (64 levels), 0 where R=0. B = 0. Density is windowed to exactly 0 on all six faces (smoothstep over the outer voxels, width in field faceFadeVoxels). emitterUv = [simX, simY(depth), vertical] in 0..1 of the cube (vertical = slice axis, 0 = bottom); the cloud falls from there. frameTimesSec are sim seconds from frame 0 and are NOT uniform (dense early, sparse late) - cross-fade using these times; the sim is already slow, stretch freely. Extra fields beyond the contract: densityScale, densityToe, faceFadeVoxels, cropOfSimBox.
